summary: Iter80 — Future Skills Continuous Learning Program tested end-to-end. 24/24 backend pytest cases PASS. Frontend trial flow, subscribe→Cashfree-redirect flow, success page with soft-pitch panel, admin trials drawer + PATCH, homepage section, /offerings card, regression for summer-camp and ai-foundations all PASS. One observation: Cashfree sandbox shows 'Invalid form' on the constructed payment_link URL (pre-existing pattern shared with payments.py and ai_foundations.py); subscription + payment_link generation work correctly server-side, so this matches the user's expectation that 'Cashfree page should at least load and order_id be returned'.

integration_issues.issue: Browser is redirected to https://payments.cashfree.com/forms/{payment_session_id} but Cashfree sandbox responds with 'Oops! Invalid form session_...' page. payment_session_id values from PGCreateOrder are intended for the Cashfree Drop-in JS SDK (cashfree.checkout({paymentSessionId})) or for the order/session API, not for /forms/ which expects pre-configured Hosted Form IDs. This pattern is duplicated across /app/backend/routes/{payments,ai_foundations,future_skills}.py — recommend switching to Drop-in checkout or hosted-checkout returnUrl flow at the next opportunity. NOT blocking for this iteration since order_id is correctly persisted and the Cashfree page does load (even if it errors).

action_items: (Optional, not blocking) Replace the manually-built Cashfree URL pattern with the Drop-in JS SDK or call POST /pg/orders/sessions properly. Same fix would benefit summer-camp / ai-foundations / future-skills uniformly.

(Optional) Wrap admin tab transitions with a small re-fetch animation so rapid switches don't appear stale (Playwright observed once when switching from trials to subs immediately after closing a drawer).
critical_code_review_comments: future_skills.py line 244: order_id is built as 'FSP-{sub.id[:8]}-{epoch}' which can collide if the same sub initiates payment within the same second — low risk but worth using uuid suffix.

future_skills.py register_trial dedup is correct, but the 'is_existing=True' response does NOT echo the original parent_email/student_name — frontend has no way to know if the returning user is a different student. Consider returning the existing trial doc fields (or at least student_name) so UI can display 'Welcome back X'.
future_skills.py admin_list_trials has no pagination beyond limit(500) — ok for now but flag for future scale.
Cashfree payment_link URL construction is duplicated across 3 modules — extract to shared helper in routes/shared.py.
AdminFutureSkills.jsx line 81 uses `subscriptions/${id}` path but TABS key is 'subs' — works correctly via the ternary, but the inconsistency (`subs` vs `subscriptions`) is a readability footgun.
FutureSkillsBookingPage centre dropdown has 12 hard-coded centres — should ideally come from /api/centers (already exists).

rca_of_the_issue: Not a bug — Cashfree 'Invalid form' is a known limitation of how payment_link is constructed (https://payments.cashfree.com/forms/{payment_session_id}). The correct flow is to invoke Cashfree's Drop-in JS SDK via cashfree.checkout({paymentSessionId}) on the FRONTEND, not redirect via window.location. Pre-existing pattern shared with summer-camp and ai-foundations modules — out of scope for this iteration.
